summary: Unified multimodal AI Studio (ChatGPT-like) verified end-to-end. Backend /agent endpoint correctly routes intent (chat/code/image/webapp) via LLM and returns kind+media. Webapp is properly backgrounded (fast return in <40s) and completes via /creations/{cid}/status polling to 'done' with a valid HTML url. Frontend Chat.js renders each kind inline: text markdown, code block with Copy button, image with Download, and live iframe webapp preview with Open/Download. Sidebar renamed to 'AI Studio'; old Create Studio route removed. Sessions CRUD (new/select/delete) and Billing credits link intact.
critical_code_review_comments: chat_agent (studio/router.py) is ~110 lines with per-action branches; consider extracting to small handler functions to keep the file focused as more modalities are added.

/app/create currently falls through to the landing page (route removed but no explicit redirect). Consider adding an explicit <Route path="create" element={<Navigate to="chat" replace />} /> for cleaner UX if any user bookmarks exist.

In chat_agent, POST /agent inserts the user message before route_intent runs; if route_intent fails no assistant message is stored (user message orphaned). Not blocking, but a try/except around routing that inserts an error assistant bubble would be more resilient.
Old /chat/sessions/{sid}/send and /stream endpoints still exist alongside /agent — dead code path for the unified UI; keep intentional if API consumers use it, otherwise remove.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ chat sessions and creations (image, code, webapp) under Admin Org via the /agent endpoint during testing. Non-destructive; can be cleaned up via UI delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_unified_agent.py covers plain chat, code, image, webapp (backgrounded + polling to done + HTML fetch), messages persistence with kind+media, and session CRUD. Video path intentionally not exercised (mirrors webapp pattern; costs real money and takes minutes). Frontend Chat.js data-testids used: chat-input, chat-send-btn, new-chat-btn, chat-session-<id>, chat-suggestion-0..4, chat-msg-user/assistant, chat-image, chat-voice, chat-video(-processing), chat-code, chat-webapp(-processing), webapp-open-btn, copy-code-btn. Login button is 'Log in' (not 'Sign in'). Successful login lands at /app (not /app/<something>) so use wait_for_url('**/app**').
